discoveryTimeout.title: Discovery Timeout (seconds)
discoveryTimeout.description: How long to wait for the Deako WiFi bridge to appear via mDNS before giving up.

pingInterval.title: Ping Interval (seconds)
pingInterval.description: How often to send a keep-alive ping to the Deako bridge.

reconnectInterval.title: Reconnect Interval (seconds)
reconnectInterval.description: How long to wait before attempting to reconnect after a disconnection.

refreshInterval.title: Device Refresh Interval (seconds)
refreshInterval.description: How often to request a full device list refresh to remove stale accessories.
